changes: Team: one responsive modal up to 900px, existing member assignment and existing email invitation API, close/refresh/toast on success.
Reviews: owner-only workspace list over project_feedback, submitted completed/archived feedback, author/email, project links and inclusive timezone-aware date bounds; bounded pagination.
Global personal settings reuse the existing collapsible project navigation component.
Agent: optional existing shared key select, no type/permission/key-creation controls; Active at bottom; new kind agent, existing kinds unchanged.

authorizationPolicy: Legacy registration permission flags are retained as compatibility metadata and no longer restrict operations. Review broad keys that previously relied on those flags before installation. Credential scope arrays/hashes and existing agent kinds are not rewritten.
